children: Arkham said it has tracked about 78% of Strategy's 847,700 bitcoin holdings. According to Odaily, the tagged wallet assets are worth $40.28 billion, while another $15.5 billion in assets are marked as held by Fidelity Custody. In the snapshot, Strategy's bitcoin reserves were valued at $71.4 billion. Saylor had previously said the addresses would not be made public. Arkham first tagged most of the holdings in May 2025, and the remaining holdings have not been identified.

title: Arkham Says It Has Tracked About 78% of Strategy's Bitcoin Holdings
